name: Murlocs at the Gates
label: Quest
description: Murlocs at the Gates: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.

A tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.

clips.title: Completion
paras: We appreciate the assistance. I'm sure this won't stop the attacks entirely, but it'll hopefully slow them down a bit. It's hard enough rebuilding this place without a murloc trying to stab you in the back with a spear.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
